## FAQs

How long does it take to get my order?


Production time on all orders varies. The most up to date production time will be found in each listing. Rush options are available in the link in each listing as well.


Care instructions


Since all items are made with high quality outdoor vinyl, it is NOT recommended to dishwash or microwave as heat can ruin the vinyl. Wash with warm soapy water!


What are these made out of?


All of my items are designed by me and cut to order with high-quality outdoor vinyl (not to be confused with paint or stickers). It is your responsibility to understand what vinyl is before purchasing. All listings make it very clear that the glasses, tumblers, tote bags, etc. are personalized with vinyl. If you are not sure what vinyl is, please feel free to ask us any questions you have before placing your order.


Do you make proofs or digital images for my order?


I focus on creating and getting orders shipped as quickly as possible. For this reason, I do not send proofs of designs and/or colors before production, or send pictures of finished products prior to shipping. Thank you for your understanding!
